==> haproxy/haproxy.cfg (haproxy, whole file)
# Managed by Switchyard. Do not edit: changes are reported as drift.
# SE group: edge
# switchyard-render: sha256:52c16d8f4dd59a297d0392e9c3b534db65dfeb72b79953a92c44e567f67cffd2

global
    log /dev/log local0
    maxconn 20000
    stats socket /run/haproxy/admin.sock mode 660 level admin expose-fd listeners
    ssl-default-bind-options ssl-min-ver TLSv1.2 no-tls-tickets
    ssl-default-server-options ssl-min-ver TLSv1.2

defaults
    log global
    option dontlognull
    option redispatch
    retries 3
    timeout connect 5s
    timeout client 50s
    timeout server 50s
    timeout http-request 10s
    timeout http-keep-alive 10s
    timeout tunnel 1h

# Local health endpoint for keepalived's check script and the agent's route-health watchdog.
frontend sy_local_health
    mode http
    bind 127.0.0.1:8404
    monitor-uri /healthz
    no log

frontend vs_external-sni
    mode http
    bind 192.0.2.20:80
    bind 192.0.2.20:443 ssl crt-list /etc/switchyard/certs/external-sni.crtlist alpn h2,http/1.1,acme-tls/1
    bind 192.0.2.20:6789
    bind 192.0.2.20:8075
    bind 192.0.2.20:8682
    bind 192.0.2.20:8843 ssl crt-list /etc/switchyard/certs/external-sni.crtlist alpn http/1.1,acme-tls/1
    bind 192.0.2.20:8880
    option httplog
    option forwardfor
    tcp-request session reject if !{ src -f /etc/switchyard/haproxy/lists/cloudflare-ranges.cidr }
    http-request return status 200 content-type text/plain lf-string "%[path,map(/etc/switchyard/haproxy/maps/acme-http01.map)]" if { dst_port 80 } { path,map(/etc/switchyard/haproxy/maps/acme-http01.map) -m found }
    http-request set-var(txn.trusted) bool(true) if { src -f /etc/switchyard/haproxy/lists/cloudflare-ranges.cidr }
    http-request set-src hdr(CF-Connecting-IP) if { var(txn.trusted) -m bool } { hdr(CF-Connecting-IP) -m found }
    http-request del-header CF-Connecting-IP if !{ var(txn.trusted) -m bool }
    http-request del-header X-Forwarded-For
    http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Proto https if { ssl_fc }
    http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Proto http if !{ ssl_fc }
    http-request set-var(txn.host) req.hdr(host),field(1,:),lower
    http-request redirect prefix "https://%[var(txn.host)]" code 301 if { dst_port 80 }
    http-request redirect location /remote.php/dav/ code 301 if { var(txn.host) -m str files.files.example.org } { path_beg /.well-known/carddav }
    http-request redirect location /remote.php/dav/ code 301 if { var(txn.host) -m str files.files.example.org } { path_beg /.well-known/caldav }
    use_backend %[var(txn.host),map(/etc/switchyard/haproxy/maps/external-sni-host.map)] if { var(txn.host),map(/etc/switchyard/haproxy/maps/external-sni-host.map) -m found }
    default_backend pool_ubiquiti

frontend vs_rke-prd-clus-01
    mode tcp
    bind 192.0.2.27:80
    bind 192.0.2.27:443
    bind 192.0.2.27:6443
    bind 192.0.2.27:9345
    option tcplog
    default_backend pool_rke-nodes

backend pool_billing
    mode http
    balance roundrobin
    stick-table type ipv6 size 100000 expire 1800s
    stick on src
    option httpchk
    http-check send meth GET uri /
    http-check expect status 200,204,301,302,401
    timeout check 3s
    default-server inter 5s fall 3 rise 2
    server 10-60-1-2-443 10.60.1.2:443 check check-ssl ssl verify none sni req.hdr(host),field(1,:),lower weight 100
    server 10-60-1-3-443 10.60.1.3:443 check check-ssl ssl verify none sni req.hdr(host),field(1,:),lower weight 100

backend pool_headscale
    mode http
    balance roundrobin
    option httpchk
    http-check send meth GET uri /
    http-check expect status 200,204,301,302,401
    timeout check 3s
    default-server inter 5s fall 3 rise 2
    server 10-60-5-182-8080 10.60.5.182:8080 check weight 100

backend pool_insurance

    default-server inter 5s fall 3 rise 2
    server 10-61-0-3-443 10.61.0.3:443 check check-ssl ssl verify none sni req.hdr(host),field(1,:),lower weight 100
